arxiv-1509-07990.title: Cortical microtubule nucleation can organise the cytoskeleton of Drosophila oocytes to define the anteroposterior axis This paper has been published: eLife 4 , e06088 (2015). DOI: http://dx.doi.org/10.7554/eLife.06088
arxiv-1509-07990.creator: Philipp Khuc Trong 1,2 , Hélène Doerflinger 3 , Jörn Dunkel 1,4 , Daniel St. Johnston 3 , and Raymond E. Goldstein 1
arxiv-1509-07990.description: Abstract Many cells contain non-centrosomal arrays of microtubules (MT), but the assembly, organisation and function of these arrays are poorly understood. We present the first theoretical model for the non-centrosomal MT cytoskeleton in Drosophila oocytes, in which bicoid and oskar mRNAs become localised to establish the anterior-posterior body axis.

Oller, [0.5em] School of Physics, Southeast University, Nanjing 211189, China, [0.2em] Department of Physics and Hebei Advanced Thin Films Laboratory, Hebei Normal University, Shijiazhuang 050024, China, [0.2em] Departamento de Física. The recently discovered fully charmed tetraquark candidate X ⁡ ( 6900 ) X(6900) is analyzed within the frameworks of effective-range expansion, compositeness relation and width saturation, and a coupled multichannel dynamical study.

arxiv-2012-07644.title: JUDE (Jayant’s UVIT Data Explorer) Pipeline User Manual
arxiv-2012-07644.creator: P T Rahna 1*,2, Jayant Murthy 1 and Margarita Safonova 1
arxiv-2012-07644.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by P T Rahna 1*,2, Jayant Murthy 1 and Margarita Safonova 1. We have written a reference manual to use JUDE (Jayant’s UVIT data Explorer) data pipeline software for processing and reducing the Ultraviolet Imaging Telescope (UVIT) Level 1 data into event lists and images – Level 2 data. The JUDE pipeline is written in the GNU Data Language (GDL) and released as an open-source which may be freely used and modified.

arxiv-2101-10784.title: Data-Driven Set-Based Estimation using Matrix Zonotopes with Set Containment Guarantees Thanks: ∗ Authors are with equal contributions. 1 The author is with Jacobs University, Bremen. a.alanwar@jacobs-university.de . 2 The authors are with the Division of Decision and Control Systems at KTH Royal In
arxiv-2101-10784.creator: Amr Alanwar, Alexander Berndt, Karl Henrik Johansson, Henrik Sandberg
arxiv-2101-10784.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Amr Alanwar, Alexander Berndt, Karl Henrik Johansson, Henrik Sandberg. We propose a method to perform set-based state estimation of an unknown dynamical linear system using a data-driven set propagation function. Our method comes with set-containment guarantees, making it applicable to safety-critical systems.

arxiv-2110-02172.title: Affine Deligne-Lusztig Varieties and Quantum Bruhat Graph
arxiv-2110-02172.creator: Arghya Sadhukhan
arxiv-2110-02172.description: Abstract . In this paper, we consider affine Deligne-Lusztig varieties X w ​ ( b ) X_{w}(b) and their certain union X ⁡ ( μ , b ) X(\mu,b) inside the affine flag variety of a reductive group. Several important results in the study of affine Deligne-Lusztig varieties have been established under the so-called superregularity hypothesis.

arxiv-2208-14492.title: R R -dependence of inclusive jet suppression and groomed jet splittings in heavy-ion collisions with ALICE Thanks: Presented at the 29th International Conference on Ultrarelativistic Nucleus-Nucleus Collisions
arxiv-2208-14492.creator: Hannah Bossi for the ALICE Collaboration
arxiv-2208-14492.description: Abstract Jets in relativistic heavy-ion collisions (HICs) interact with the quark-gluon plasma (QGP), leading to effects such as a suppression of jet yields and a modification of internal jet structure that are used to measure the properties of the QGP.

arxiv-2210-14918.title: Multiferroicity and Topology in Twisted Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
arxiv-2210-14918.creator: Ahmed Abouelkomsan, Emil J. Bergholtz, Shubhayu Chatterjee
arxiv-2210-14918.description: Abstract Van der Waals heterostructures have recently emerged as an exciting platform for investigating the effects of strong electronic correlations, including various forms of magnetic or electrical orders. Here, we perform an unbiased exact diagonalization study of the effects of interactions on topological flat bands of twisted transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) at odd integer fillings.

arxiv-2401-14987.title: Null-controllability for the beam equation with structural damping. Part 1. Distributed control
arxiv-2401-14987.creator: Sergei Avdonin, Julian Edward, Sergei Ivanov
arxiv-2401-14987.description: Abstract Let Δ \Delta be the Dirichlet Laplacian on the interval ( 0 , π ) (0,\pi) . The null controllability properties of the equation u t ​ t + Δ 2 ​ u + ρ ​ ( Δ ) α ​ u t = F ⁡ ( x , t ) u_{tt}+\Delta^{2}u+\rho(\Delta)^{\alpha}u_{t}=F(x,t) are studied.

arxiv-2403-13474.title: Iterative Active-Inactive Obstacle Classification for Time-Optimal Collision Avoidance
arxiv-2403-13474.creator: Mehmetcan Kaymaz, Nazim Kemal Ure
arxiv-2403-13474.description: Abstract Time-optimal obstacle avoidance is a prevalent problem encountered in various fields, including robotics and autonomous vehicles, where the task involves determining a path for a moving vehicle to reach its goal while navigating around obstacles within its environment. This problem becomes increasingly challenging as the number of obstacles in the environment rises.

arxiv-2403-19609.title: Angular dependence in transverse momentum dependent diffractive parton distributions at small- x x
arxiv-2403-19609.creator: Yoshitaka Hatta, Feng Yuan
arxiv-2403-19609.description: Abstract We discuss the angular dependence of the recently proposed transverse momentum dependent quark and gluon diffractive parton distributions at small- x x . We introduce the difractive versions of the Sivers function and the elliptic gluon Wigner distribution and evaluate them in simple models with gluon saturation and study their geometric scaling properties.

arxiv-2411-08839.title: Sparser Abelian High Dimensional Expanders
arxiv-2411-08839.creator: Yotam Dikstein, Siqi Liu, Avi Wigderson
arxiv-2411-08839.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yotam Dikstein, Siqi Liu, Avi Wigderson. We present two new explicit constructions of Cayley high dimensional expanders (HDXs) over the abelian group 𝔽 2 n \mathbb{F}_{2}^{n} . Our expansion proofs use only linear algebra and combinatorial arguments. The first construction gives local spectral HDXs of any constant dimension and subpolynomial degree exp ⁡ ( n ε ) \exp(n^{\varepsilon}) for every ε > 0 \varepsilon>0 , improving on a construction by Golowich [ Gol23 ] which achieves ε = 1 / 2 \varepsilon=1/2 .

arxiv-2507-19572.title: Accelerating magnonic simulations with the pseudospectral Landau-Lifshitz equation
arxiv-2507-19572.creator: A. Roxburgh, M. Copus, E. Iacocca
arxiv-2507-19572.description: Abstract The pseudospectral Landau-Lifshitz (PS-LL) model can describe atomic-scale magnetic exchange interactions within a continuum framework. This is achieved by employing a convolution kernel that models the nonlocal interaction in a grid-independent manner. Even though the PS-LL was originally introduced to address atomic exchange, any nonlocal kernel can be modeled.

arxiv-2508-01866.title: Separation Logic of Generic Resources via Sheafeology CCS: Theory of computation Concurrency CCS: Theory of computation Logic and verification CCS: Theory of computation Separation logic CCS: Theory of computation Program verification
arxiv-2508-01866.creator: Berend van Starkenburg, Henning Basold, Chase Ford
arxiv-2508-01866.description: Abstract . Separation logic was originally conceived in order to make the verification of pointer programs scalable to large systems and it has been extremely effective at that. The principle idea is that programs typically do not have to interact with the whole available memory, but only small parts on which reasoning can thus be focused.

plos-pbio-0020330.creator: Konrad P Körding, Izumi Fukunaga, Ian S Howard et al.
plos-pbio-0020330.description: PLOS ONE research article. Making choices is a fundamental aspect of human life. For over a century experimental economists have characterized the decisions people make based on the concept of a utility function. This function increases with increasing desirability of the outcome, and people are assumed to

pmc-10737636.title: REFERRAL OF ASIANS TO SKILLED NURSING FACILITIES: FINDINGS FROM THE 2019 NATIONAL MEDICARE DATA
pmc-10737636.creator: Hoang Nguyen, Chih-Ying Li, Huey-Ming Tzeng, Md Ibrahim Tahashilder, Yong-Fang Kuo
pmc-10737636.description: A recent study of skilled nursing facilities (SNF) found Asian/Pacific Islanders are the most physically dependent and have the greatest cognitive impairment among all residents. Whether or not this is due to differential referral pattern to skilled nursing facilities is not known.

pmc-11352030.title: Trajectory of Irisin as a Predictor of Kidney-Related Outcomes in Patients with Asymptomatic Heart Failure
pmc-11352030.creator: Tetiana A Berezina, Oleksandr O Berezin, Uta C Hoppe, Michael Lichtenauer, Alexander E Berezin, Alice Santos-Silva, Susana Coimbra
pmc-11352030.description: The purpose of the study is to elucidate whether irisin is a promising predictive biomarker for kidney-related events in patients with T2DM and concomitant asymptomatic HF. We prospectively enrolled 146 T2DM patients who had either evidence of structural cardiac abnormality or elevated levels of N-terminal brain natriuretic pro-peptide (NT-proBNP) > 125 pmol/mL and followed them for 52 weeks.

pmc-11427523.title: Not a Benign (Mis)Label: Penicillin Allergy Education for the Nonallergist
pmc-11427523.creator: Jessica Plager, William B. Cutrer
pmc-11427523.description: IntroductionUp to 20% of the US population carries a penicillin allergy label; however, over 95% of those patients can safely tolerate penicillin. This discrepancy has important personal and public health consequences. There is no published curriculum for medical trainees that covers penicillin allergy history taking, risk assessment, and antibiotic prescribing.

pmc-11432389.title: Polyethylene Micro/Nanoplastics Exposure Induces Epithelial–Mesenchymal Transition in Human Bronchial and Alveolar Epithelial Cells
pmc-11432389.creator: Alice Traversa, Emanuela Mari, Paola Pontecorvi, Giulia Gerini, Enrico Romano, Francesca Megiorni, Amedeo Amedei, Cinzia Marchese, Danilo Ranieri, Simona Ceccarelli
pmc-11432389.description: Micro/nanoplastics (MNPs), which are widely spread in the environment, have gained attention because of their ability to enter the human body mainly through ingestion, inhalation, and skin contact, thus representing a serious health threat. Several studies have reported the presence of MNPs in lung tissue and the potential role of MNP inhalation in triggering lung fibrosis and tumorigenesis.

pmc-11647246.title: Inhibitory maturation and ocular dominance plasticity in mouse visual cortex require astrocyte CB1 receptors
pmc-11647246.creator: Rogier Min, Yi Qin, Sven Kerst, M Hadi Saiepour, Mariska van Lier, Christiaan N Levelt
pmc-11647246.description: SummaryEndocannabinoids, signaling through the cannabinoid CB1 receptor (CB1R), regulate several forms of neuronal plasticity. CB1Rs in the developing primary visual cortex (V1) play a key role in the maturation of inhibitory circuits. Although CB1Rs were originally thought to reside mainly on presynaptic axon terminals, several studies have highlighted an unexpected role for astrocytic CB1Rs in endocannabinoid mediated plasticity.

pmc-11650264.title: Improving gel properties of egg white protein using coconut endosperm dietary fibers modified by ultrasound and dual enzymolysis combined with carboxymethylation or phosphate crosslinking
pmc-11650264.creator: Anyu Zhang, Jun Ma, Peiyao Long, Yajun Zheng, Yichan Zhang
pmc-11650264.description: Coconut endosperm residue is a rich dietary fiber resource; however, its hydration properties are poor. To enhance the functionality and applications of coconut endosperm residue dietary fiber (CERDF) in the food industry, ultrasound, cellulase, and hemicellulase hydrolysis combined with carboxymethylation or phosphate crosslinking have been used.

pmc-12003852.title: Coronary inflammation and AI-Risk scores from cardiovascular computed tomography: impact on risk prediction and clinical management in a real-world setting
pmc-12003852.creator: John A Henry, Susannah M Black, Oliver G J Mitchell, Edward Richardson, Cameron Watson, Chris Hare, Pierre Le Page, Andrew R J Mitchell
pmc-12003852.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). AimsCoronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) is the primary investigation for stable chest pain. Despite approximately 80% of individuals undergoing CCTA not having obstructive coronary disease, this group contributes to two-thirds of major adverse cardiovascular events. Assessment of coronary inflammation using perivascular fat attenuation index (FAI) and AI-derived risk scores (AI-Risk) has demonstrated enhanced risk prediction beyond traditional clinical and CCTA parameters.

pmc-12562555.title: Fluoroquinolone-Induced Achilles Tendon Damage: Structural and Biochemical Insights into Collagen Type I Alterations
pmc-12562555.creator: Magdalena J. Romanowska, Jakub P. Adamus, Sławomir Struzik, Leszek Paczek
pmc-12562555.description: Fluoroquinolones, one of the most frequently used antibiotics, despite their wide spectrum of beneficial activity, are linked to serious adverse effects such as tendinopathies. Tendon injuries connected to the use of the group of drugs frequently affect the Achilles tendon—an anatomical structure, crucial to the proper mobility of lower limb, that is made of collagen fibers and extracellular matrix (ECM).

pmc-12766328.title: Fluoridated milk is effective in prevention of enamel caries in adolescents: a randomised trial
pmc-12766328.creator: Madeleine Rohlin, Jessica Neilands, Julia R. Davies, Per-Erik Isberg, Claes Wickström, Gunnel Svensäter
pmc-12766328.description: ObjectiveTo investigate whether low daily doses of fluoridated milk, as an adjunct to oral hygiene routines with fluoridated toothpaste, can prevent caries development in enamel and dentine in adolescents.Material and methodsAdolescents (mean age 13 years) at three dental clinics in Sweden were enrolled to a randomised clinical trial (RCT) including baseline and 2-year follow-up examinations.

pmc-12796396.title: Clinical validation of new alzheimer disease diagnosis tools based on plasma p-Tau217
pmc-12796396.creator: Aleix Martí-Navia, Lourdes Álvarez-Sánchez, Laura Ferré-González, Alejandro López, Carmen Peña-Bautista, Ángel Balaguer, Nevenka Pedrosa, Helena Vico, Miguel Baquero, Consuelo Cháfer-Pericás
pmc-12796396.description: Nowadays, there is an unmet need for reliable and minimally-invasive diagnosis tools capable of detecting Alzheimer’s disease at early stages. Such tools could significantly reduce the reliance on confirmatory tests that are invasive and costly, such as cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) biomarkers and neuroimaging.

pmc-12982395.title: Clinical characteristics analysis of pertussis and Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection in children
pmc-12982395.creator: Min Xue, Xiaoling Wei, Bing Wang, Miao Liu, Yun Zhang, Xiang Ma
pmc-12982395.description: ObjectiveTo analyze the clinical differences between pertussis and/or Mycoplasma pneumoniae (MP) infections in children and provide insights for clinical differential diagnosis.MethodsWe retrospectively reviewed children with respiratory symptoms who attended Shandong University Children’s Hospital (Jinan, China) from 2019 to 2024 and underwent simultaneous testing for pertussis and MP.

pmc-13045370.title: One Case of Transvaginal and Transabdominal Oocyte Retrieval Guided by Ultrasound Probe: A Case Report
pmc-13045370.creator: Qiaoqiao Lu, Jianying He, Ning Zheng
pmc-13045370.description: Transvaginal ultrasound‐guided oocyte retrieval is routine for assisted reproduction, but unfit for some special patients. We report an elderly infertile patient with adenomyosis, whose transvaginal retrieval was high risk. Intraoperative conversion to transabdominal retrieval succeeded safely. For high‐risk transvaginal oocyte retrieval patients, transabdominal retrieval is safe and feasible.

pmc-13310773.title: Intensified MR-guided pulsed adaptive cancer treatment- a potential new treatment option for large(>5cm) central non-small cell lung cancer, a case report
pmc-13310773.creator: Maciej Blok, Tomasz Wisniewski, Izabela Wiatrowska, Maciej Harat

pmc-13712289.title: Discovery of a potent covalent inhibitor for the treatment of sepsis targeting DNAJC9: Identification of a druggable target for inflammation
pmc-13712289.creator: Xingjun Li, Tao Yang, Hui Huang, Yalan Ma, Lu Liu, Qingqing Li, Naixia Zhang, Zhizhen Hui, Yazhou Li, Fang Bai, Qiangqiang Chen, Jiang Wang, Chen Zhou, Hu Zhou, Wei Tang, Hong Liu
pmc-13712289.description: Sepsis is a leading cause of mortality among patients in intensive care units (ICUs), with no specific treatments for sepsis available in clinical practice. In this study, we report the discovery of compound A12, a tanshinone derivative featuring a covalent warhead, which demonstrates potent anti-inflammatory effects both in vitro and in vivo.

uslaw-usc-t46-s8906.title: 46 U.S.C. § 8906 — Penalty
uslaw-usc-t46-s8906.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s8906.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part F (Manning Of Vessels); Chapter 89 (Small Vessel Manning). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. An owner, charterer, managing operator, agent, master, or individual in charge of a vessel operated in violation of this chapter or a regulation prescribed under this chapter is liable to the United States Government for a civil penalty of not more.
